_comment: ElevenLabs voice IDs for the 12 apprentice archetypes × 2 genders (24 voices). Voice direction sourced from apps/shared/apprentices.ts. Consumed by apps/scripts/generate_apprentice_vo.py.

zealot.direction: Fervent, rising cadence. Quotes scripture they wrote. Breathless with purpose.

ghost.direction: Quiet, spare words. Never fills silence. Speaks more in glances than sentences.

scholar.direction: Precise, academic, cites sources. Cannot resist correcting errors even at bad times.

revenant.direction: Slow, measured, slightly echoing. Speaks as if from elsewhere. Long pauses.

artisan.direction: Unhurried, technical, small satisfactions in descriptions. Hums while working.

oracle.direction: Distracted, half-elsewhere. Switches topic mid-sentence. Finishes others' thoughts wrongly.

wanderer.direction: Easy, drifty, quick to change subject. Stories from ten places, all interrupted.

martyr.direction: Gentle, reassuring. Minimizes their own pain. Apologizes for inconveniencing you.

heretic.direction: Sharp, rhetorical, uses silence as weapon. Does not laugh at authority's jokes.

jester.direction: Quick, bright, punchlines. Drops into gravitas without warning, then masks it.

sentinel.direction: Clipped, professional, operator-cadence. Brief acknowledgments, long watches.

prodigal.direction: Rough edges, half-apologetic. Avoids eye contact on old topics. Direct on new ones.
